problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign a collection of freight boxes onto identical pallets for air shipment. The cargo items are as follows:

* Box Alpha: mass 54 kg  
* Box Beta: mass 33 kg  
* Box Gamma: mass 57 kg  
* Box Delta: mass 58 kg  
* Box Epsilon: mass 61 kg  
* Box Zeta: mass 40 kg  
* Box Eta: mass 43 kg  
* Box Theta: mass 70 kg  
* Box Iota: mass 37 kg  
* Box Kappa: mass 64 kg  
* Box Lambda: mass 63 kg  
* Box Mu: mass 36 kg  
* Box Nu: mass 63 kg  
* Box Xi: mass 43 kg  
* Box Omicron: mass 70 kg  
* Box Pi: mass 65 kg  
* Box Rho: mass 55 kg  
* Box Sigma: mass 50 kg  
* Box Tau: mass 47 kg  
* Box Upsilon: mass 44 kg  
* Box Phi: mass 68 kg  
* Box Chi: mass 33 kg  
* Box Psi: mass 50 kg  
* Box Omega: mass 47 kg  
* Box A1: mass 35 kg  
* Box B1: mass 68 kg  
* Box C1: mass 67 kg  
* Box D1: mass 41 kg  
* Box E1: mass 36 kg  
* Box F1: mass 59 kg  
* Box G1: mass 31 kg  
* Box H1: mass 60 kg  
* Box I1: mass 52 kg  
* Box J1: mass 46 kg  
* Box K1: mass 57 kg  

Each pallet has a strict maximum load capacity of 100 kilograms. The objective is to load all boxes while utilizing the smallest possible number of pallets. Every box must be placed on exactly one pallet, and the combined mass on any pallet must not surpass its weight limit.
